purpose: Prefer a drastic alternative to an unacceptable choice.
keywords: I would rather stay silent than lie.
If you are going to throw it away, please give it to me.
Rather than force ourselves to continue, let’s take a break.
restrictions: The first action is strongly rejected; the second is preferable.
mistake: This is not an ordinary neutral conditional.
